What we do

One contract, every soft service your building runs on

Directly employed teams, one account manager, one monthly report — across a single site or a national portfolio.

Daily office cleaning

Day and night teams on a scoped specification, audited monthly against a published standard.

Kitchen extract & ductwork

TR19-compliant deep cleans with pre and post photographic evidence and a certificate for your insurer.

Washroom & hygiene

Consumables, sanitary disposal and periodic deep cleans on a schedule that matches real footfall.

Specialist & periodic

Carpets, hard floors, high-level and façade work planned around the hours your building is quiet.

Waste & recycling

Segregated streams, duty-of-care paperwork and diversion figures you can put in an ESG report.

Front of house

Reception, post room and helpdesk cover, trained to your brand rather than to ours.

How it starts

A conversation, then a walk-through — never a guessed price

Tell us the building, the hours and what is going wrong today. A surveyor confirms the scope on site, and the quotation follows from what they measured.

1 · Tell us the brief

Two minutes in the chat, or a call. Site type, size, hours and the services you are looking at.

2 · We walk the site

A surveyor measures the areas, photographs the condition and agrees the specification with you.

3 · You get a priced proposal

Line by line against the specification, with the mobilisation plan and the audit regime attached.
